source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: What I Wish I Knew Before I Became A Parent

lines.en: Most mothers will inevitably experience this moment: two little lines on a test, a definitive marker in your life.
lines.zh: 大多數媽媽都一定會經歷這一刻：驗孕棒上的兩條線，人生中一個決定性的標記。

lines.en: You are going to be a parent.
lines.zh: 你要當爸媽了。

lines.en: Now, the typical reaction that many think new mothers will feel is this: "Yes! Yes! Oh my God!"
lines.zh: 很多人以為新手媽媽的典型反應是這樣：「耶！耶！我的天啊！」

lines.en: But sometimes it could look like this: "Oh my God. Oh my God."
lines.zh: 但有時候可能是這樣：「天啊……天啊……」

lines.en: Well, that's what my reaction looked like.
lines.zh: 嗯，我的反應就是那樣。

lines.en: Anxiety-inducing.
lines.zh: 讓人焦慮。

lines.en: Despite all conditions pointing to an appropriate time, it still didn't feel like the right time.
lines.zh: 儘管所有條件都顯示這是個適當的時機，感覺上還是不對。

lines.en: And if I'm honest, I don't think there ever would have been the perfect time for me.
lines.zh: 老實說，我不覺得對我來說會有什麼完美的時機。

lines.en: It just kind of happened, and sometimes parenthood starts like that.
lines.zh: 它就這樣發生了，有時候當父母就是這樣開始的。

lines.en: So in this video, I want to break down the reality of becoming a parent, well, at least for me.
lines.zh: 所以在這支影片裡，我想拆解一下成為父母的真實樣貌，嗯，至少是我的版本。

lines.en: Let's face it, we all have a very strange relationship with change.
lines.zh: 面對現實吧，我們和「改變」之間的關係都很奇怪。

lines.en: We all know we need to change, but only on our own terms and conditions.
lines.zh: 我們都知道自己需要改變，但只接受照自己的條件來改變。

lines.en: We're more than happy to change what kind of beverage we order or change an outfit.
lines.zh: 要換點不同的飲料、換一套衣服，我們都很樂意。

lines.en: But when it's an unprecedented change that's completely out of our control, now that is when we resist the most.
lines.zh: 但當那是前所未有、完全不在我們掌控中的改變時，就是我們最抗拒的時候。

lines.en: So what does change look like when you become a parent?
lines.zh: 那麼，當你成為父母，改變是什麼樣子？

lines.en: For me, it felt like I had dropped down a secret trapdoor in my mind.
lines.zh: 對我來說，就像在腦中掉進了一道祕密的暗門。

lines.en: It made me see change in a profound and alarming way.
lines.zh: 它讓我用一種深刻又令人不安的方式看見改變。

lines.en: You see, it's hard to see tangible change once you reach your 30s.
lines.zh: 你知道，到了三十幾歲，就很難看到具體的改變。

lines.en: When you look in the mirror, you're still relatively yourself.
lines.zh: 照鏡子時，你大致上還是原本的你。

lines.en: Maybe a few extra fine lines, perhaps your hair is new, but overall you look pretty much the same that you did last year.
lines.zh: 也許多了幾條細紋，也許換了髮型，但整體來說，你看起來和去年差不多。

lines.en: Our children, on the other hand, are changing every day, every month, every year.
lines.zh: 相反地，我們的孩子每天、每個月、每一年都在改變。

lines.en: They become our time totems.
lines.zh: 他們成了我們的時間圖騰。

lines.en: Whenever we look at them, it's a direct reminder that things are constantly evolving, including us.
lines.zh: 每次看著他們，都是在直接提醒我們：一切都在不斷演變，包括我們自己。

lines.en: And I felt the most drastic change almost immediately after I gave birth.
lines.zh: 而我在生產後幾乎立刻就感受到最劇烈的改變。

lines.en: The old you is still there, but there's a lot of new features that you're discovering and toggling with.
lines.zh: 原本的你還在，但有很多新功能是你正在發現、正在摸索切換的。

lines.en: The physical is obvious.
lines.zh: 身體上的改變很明顯。

lines.en: Your body is unrecognizable, your boobs are finally serving their biological purpose, and your mind is undergoing a tsunami of hormones.
lines.zh: 你的身體變得認不出來，胸部終於在發揮它的生物功能，大腦則經歷一場荷爾蒙海嘯。

lines.en: It's basically trying to process that there is a tiny little human that you are now responsible for.
lines.zh: 它基本上是在努力消化：現在有一個小小的人要由你負責。

lines.en: Some people pick it up really quickly, while others take some time to accept this monumental change in their life.
lines.zh: 有些人很快就上手，有些人則需要一些時間來接受人生中這個巨大的改變。

lines.en: And no matter how many podcasts you listen to or videos that you watch or books that you consume, nothing will prepare you for parenthood until you are living through it.
lines.zh: 不管你聽了多少 podcast、看了多少影片、讀了多少書，在你親身經歷之前，沒有什麼能讓你真正準備好當父母。

lines.en: Knowledge is receiving the information, but wisdom is actually applying it into your life.
lines.zh: 知識是接收資訊，智慧則是真正把它應用在生活中。

lines.en: And the good news is, things really did settle down once my son turned one.
lines.zh: 好消息是，我兒子滿一歲之後，一切真的安定下來了。

lines.en: It was just that first year that was just the most significant of a change.
lines.zh: 就只有第一年是改變最大的時候。

lines.en: But you know, some things are really the same.
lines.zh: 不過你知道，有些事情其實還是一樣。

lines.en: Like, I'm still waking up in the morning, just at 7:00 a.m.
lines.zh: 像是我還是早上起床，只是改成七點。

lines.en: I'm still eating my meals every day, but I'm including a new menu for someone else.
lines.zh: 我還是每天吃飯，只是多了一份給另一個人的菜單。

lines.en: I still sleep at night, but I just have to do my nightly tuck-in for my son.
lines.zh: 我還是晚上睡覺，只是要先哄兒子上床、幫他蓋好被子。

lines.en: All this change made me into a stronger person, objectively.
lines.zh: 客觀來說，這些改變讓我成為更堅強的人。

lines.en: Every time I remind him not to run in the road or why we can't eat ice cream every day, it's teaching me patience.
lines.zh: 每次我提醒他不要在馬路上跑，或解釋為什麼不能每天吃冰淇淋，都在教我耐心。

lines.en: And I'm becoming a clear speaker because I have to simplify things.
lines.zh: 我也變得說話更清楚，因為我必須把事情講得簡單。

lines.en: But I think the biggest change with motherhood is now I only do the things that I truly want to do.
lines.zh: 但我覺得當媽媽之後最大的改變，是我現在只做自己真正想做的事。

lines.en: There is no buffer period.
lines.zh: 沒有緩衝期。

lines.en: If I have a decision and it's not an immediate "hell yeah," then it's a no.
lines.zh: 如果面對一個決定，我沒有立刻覺得「當然要！」，那答案就是不要。

lines.en: I have this clarity that wasn't there before.
lines.zh: 我有了以前沒有的清晰。

lines.en: I hopped on the self-development wagon in my mid-20s.
lines.zh: 我二十五歲左右搭上了自我成長的列車。

lines.en: I was working on one big long project: I wanted to be the best version I could be.
lines.zh: 我在進行一個又大又長的計畫：想成為最好的自己。

lines.en: That meant going to therapy, journaling, meditating, exercising, taking supplements.
lines.zh: 這代表要去做心理諮商、寫日記、冥想、運動、吃保健品。

lines.en: But honestly, there wasn't much on the line if I didn't want to stay consistent.
lines.zh: 但老實說，如果我沒有持之以恆，也沒什麼損失。

lines.en: In the past, there were no real repercussions if I decided to go on a week-long bender across the country.
lines.zh: 以前，就算我決定跑遍全國狂歡一整個星期，也不會有什麼真正的後果。

lines.en: But my son has been my biggest anchor in my life.
lines.zh: 但我兒子一直是我人生中最大的錨。

lines.en: Like, suddenly I cared about the longevity of my life, because I want to see my toddler grow up to be a man.
lines.zh: 像是我突然在意起自己能活多久，因為我想看著我的小不點長大成人。

lines.en: So if you want a fast pass to self-development, try parenthood.
lines.zh: 所以如果你想走自我成長的快速通道，就去當爸媽吧。

lines.en: You'll get a crash course in building patience, emotional regulation, thinking quickly on your feet, and the list goes on and on and on.
lines.zh: 你會上一堂速成課：培養耐心、情緒調節、臨機應變，還有很多很多很多。

lines.en: Your kids will bring to light all the parts of yourself that you've been avoiding.
lines.zh: 孩子會讓你一直在逃避的那些自我全都浮上檯面。

lines.en: It's like one long acid trip, simultaneously challenging and transcendent, and you'll come out on the other side finding deep meaning in it.
lines.zh: 就像一段漫長的迷幻之旅，既充滿挑戰又超脫凡俗，而你走出來之後，會在其中找到深刻的意義。

lines.en: And going to therapy was probably the best thing that I did for myself while I was processing all this change and confronting the blind spots that I didn't see.
lines.zh: 在我消化這些改變、面對自己沒看見的盲點時，去做心理諮商大概是我為自己做過最好的事。

lines.en: I also want to thank BetterHelp for sponsoring this video.
lines.zh: 我也要謝謝 BetterHelp 贊助這支影片。

lines.en: I've been going to therapy since 2017, and the sessions that I had during my pregnancy and all through my postpartum phase were invaluable.
lines.zh: 我從 2017 年開始做心理諮商，懷孕期間和整個產後階段的諮商都非常寶貴。

lines.en: I also think that putting that pressure on myself to become society's ideal mother loomed over me.
lines.zh: 我也覺得，逼自己成為社會眼中理想媽媽的那種壓力一直籠罩著我。

lines.en: But once I dropped that and I just focused on developing a deep relationship with my son, that's when something just clicked in my brain.
lines.zh: 但當我放下這些，只專注在和兒子建立深厚的關係時，腦袋裡好像有什麼東西突然開竅了。

lines.en: And BetterHelp would be a great fit for you if you too are undergoing a life-altering transition, or if you just want to explore the depths of your inner world.
lines.zh: 如果你也正在經歷改變人生的轉變，或者只是想探索自己內心深處，BetterHelp 會很適合你。

lines.en: I think one of my favorite features about BetterHelp is that there's this journaling component where you can jot down your reflections about the session.
lines.zh: 我最喜歡 BetterHelp 的功能之一，是它有寫日記的部分，可以記下你對每次諮商的反思。

lines.en: And starting therapy is seamless with BetterHelp.
lines.zh: 而且用 BetterHelp 開始諮商非常順暢。

lines.en: You just fill out a questionnaire, and you will match with a therapist in as little as a couple of days.
lines.zh: 你只要填一份問卷，最快幾天內就會配對到諮商師。

lines.en: And if the first therapist isn't the right fit, then you can easily switch until you find a therapist that you really, really connect with.
lines.zh: 如果第一位諮商師不適合，你可以輕鬆更換，直到找到真正合得來的諮商師。

lines.en: I also want to note that I've been keeping an ear out on the brand and about online therapy in general, and I found this really interesting resource.
lines.zh: 我也想說明，我一直有在留意這個品牌和線上諮商的相關討論，我找到一份很有意思的資料。

lines.en: So a licensed therapist from the channel Cinema Therapy has spoken about this topic, and I found it incredibly illuminating.
lines.zh: 頻道 Cinema Therapy 的一位執業諮商師談過這個主題，我覺得非常有啟發性。

lines.en: So I want to link that down in the description box so you guys can read it too if you're interested.
lines.zh: 所以我會把連結放在說明欄，有興趣的話你們也可以去看。

lines.en: If you are wanting to take the plunge into therapy, try BetterHelp.
lines.zh: 如果你想下定決心開始諮商，試試 BetterHelp。

lines.en: Go to my link, betterhelp.com/jenn, for 10% off your first month.
lines.zh: 透過我的連結 betterhelp.com/jenn，第一個月可享九折。

lines.en: I'll also make things really simple by putting the link in the description box, so click it open.
lines.zh: 我也會把連結放在說明欄，讓事情簡單一點，點開就可以了。

lines.en: By the time you reach the end of your 20s and 30s, you would have completed the many firsts that happen in this life: your first kiss, your first job, your first heartbreak.
lines.zh: 到了二、三十歲的尾聲，你已經經歷過人生中許多的「第一次」：初吻、第一份工作、第一次心碎。

lines.en: But eventually, all those restaurants and bars I started to go to started to blur in one long sequence.
lines.zh: 但後來，我去過的那些餐廳和酒吧，開始模糊成一長串分不清的畫面。

lines.en: At least it did for me.
lines.zh: 至少對我來說是這樣。

lines.en: Like, places started to look identical, and I think it was because the world was losing some of its mystery and I was becoming desensitized by my surroundings.
lines.zh: 各個地方開始看起來都一樣，我想是因為世界對我失去了一些神祕感，我對周遭環境變得麻木了。

lines.en: Once I had my son, that wasn't the case.
lines.zh: 有了兒子之後，就不是這樣了。

lines.en: Suddenly everything became new to me, because I was experiencing it with him for the first time.
lines.zh: 突然間一切對我都變得新鮮，因為我是第一次和他一起經歷。

lines.en: And there's something so damn magical about doing something new with someone you love.
lines.zh: 和你愛的人一起做一件新的事，真的有種說不出的魔力。

lines.en: And to my son, everything is new.
lines.zh: 而對我兒子來說，一切都是新的。

lines.en: Like, he's only been on this planet for 3 years, so something as simple as a bubble becomes a miracle.
lines.zh: 他來到這個世界才三年，所以就連泡泡這麼簡單的東西都成了奇蹟。

lines.en: With my son's fresh set of eyes and mind, it makes me take a second look and really see things with awe.
lines.zh: 透過兒子那雙新鮮的眼睛和心靈，我也會再看一眼，真正帶著驚奇去看事物。

lines.en: Everything and anything is completely new.
lines.zh: 所有的一切都是全新的。

lines.en: I remember the first time he had ice cream, his eyes got so wide, and he had ice cream smeared all over his face.
lines.zh: 我記得他第一次吃冰淇淋，眼睛睜得好大，冰淇淋沾得滿臉都是。

lines.en: Like, that memory is permanently etched into my mind.
lines.zh: 那段記憶永遠刻在我腦海裡。

lines.en: And it makes me really excited to just go to places that I've been to but have him there with me for the first time.
lines.zh: 這讓我很期待去那些我去過的地方，但這次是第一次帶著他一起去。

lines.en: I love that I'm one of his largest influences in his life, from reading the same books that I grew up reading to watching the same shows.
lines.zh: 我很喜歡自己是他生命中影響最大的人之一，從讀我小時候讀的書，到看同樣的節目。

lines.en: I'm going to take him to so many places.
lines.zh: 我要帶他去好多地方。

lines.en: Suddenly all the places that I've been to and the things that I've loved get a new lease on life.
lines.zh: 突然間，我去過的所有地方、我愛過的所有事物都重獲新生。

lines.en: And that's something that I really did not expect to love so much about parenting.
lines.zh: 這是我完全沒想到自己會在當父母這件事上這麼喜愛的部分。

lines.en: They really weren't kidding when they say it takes a village.
lines.zh: 人家說「養一個孩子需要整個村莊」，真的不是開玩笑。

lines.en: Now, I know a lot of people see self-sufficiency as a badge of honor, but I think it's nothing but a freeway to burnout.
lines.zh: 我知道很多人把凡事自己來當成一種榮譽勳章，但我覺得那只是一條通往過勞的快速道路。

lines.en: It reminds me of the African proverb: if you want to go fast, go alone, but if you want to go far, go together.
lines.zh: 這讓我想起一句非洲諺語：想走得快，就一個人走；想走得遠，就一起走。

lines.en: Yes, kids need their parents, and I feel really lucky that Lennon has both me and his dad to take care of him.
lines.zh: 是的，孩子需要父母，我很慶幸 Lennon 有我和他爸爸一起照顧他。

lines.en: But to expect that he's going to get everything just out of one or two people just isn't realistic.
lines.zh: 但期待他只從一兩個人身上得到一切，並不實際。

lines.en: At first, when I wasn't around him, I had this weird sense of guilt humming through me.
lines.zh: 一開始，只要沒在他身邊，我就會有一股奇怪的罪惡感在心裡嗡嗡作響。

lines.en: And it's this strange phenomenon called mom guilt, and it comes in all types of flavors.
lines.zh: 這是一種叫「媽媽罪惡感」的奇怪現象，而且有各式各樣的版本。

lines.en: It comes when you're not spending enough time with your kids.
lines.zh: 當你陪孩子的時間不夠時，它會出現。

lines.en: It's when you feel like you're not getting enough work done around the house or in your career.
lines.zh: 當你覺得家務或工作做得不夠時，它會出現。

lines.en: It's when you're comparing yourself to other parents.
lines.zh: 當你拿自己和其他父母比較時，它會出現。

lines.en: It's basically just feeling like you're not doing enough.
lines.zh: 基本上就是覺得自己做得不夠。

lines.en: And during this transition to motherhood, I have never been closer to both my parents.
lines.zh: 而在轉變成媽媽的這段期間，我和爸媽從來沒有這麼親近過。

lines.en: Like, I see them on a weekly basis, and this time together is just so freaking precious.
lines.zh: 我每個禮拜都會見到他們，這段相處時光真的超級珍貴。

lines.en: Before I had kids, I would see them maybe once a month.
lines.zh: 在我有孩子之前，大概一個月才見他們一次。

lines.en: And intellectually, I understood the hardship and the sacrifice they experienced when they were raising me and my brother.
lines.zh: 理智上，我明白他們養育我和哥哥時經歷的辛苦和犧牲。

lines.en: But it wasn't until after Lennon that I really felt the sheer responsibility and the pressure they felt.
lines.zh: 但直到有了 Lennon，我才真正感受到他們承擔的那份沉重責任和壓力。

lines.en: Motherhood has taught me the art of leaning on the people that are closest to me.
lines.zh: 當媽媽教會我依靠身邊最親近的人。

lines.en: It not only brought me and my family closer, but my friends.
lines.zh: 它不只讓我和家人更親近，也讓我和朋友更親近。

lines.en: I think the most obvious ones are the ones that have children.
lines.zh: 最明顯的是那些也有孩子的朋友。

lines.en: I think it's because the first few months of raising a child, it feels like hazing.
lines.zh: 我想是因為養孩子的頭幾個月，感覺就像新人入會的整人考驗。

lines.en: It's like we're part of this members-only club, a club of chosen optimism and endurance.
lines.zh: 就像我們都加入了一個會員限定的俱樂部，一個選擇樂觀與堅忍的俱樂部。

lines.en: So when we have our playdates, it's not only our children that are socializing and developing.
lines.zh: 所以當我們約小孩一起玩時，不只是孩子在社交、在成長。

lines.en: It's also a place for us to restore, vent, and connect, and also get some new ideas too.
lines.zh: 那也是我們充電、發洩、交流的地方，還能得到一些新點子。

lines.en: My friendships not only strengthened with my mom friends, but also my friends without kids.
lines.zh: 我不只和媽媽朋友的友誼更深了，和沒有孩子的朋友也是。

lines.en: Like, I've made aunties and uncles of a lot of my friends.
lines.zh: 我讓很多朋友都當上了阿姨和叔叔。

lines.en: And for some of them, it was their first time really interacting with a child.
lines.zh: 對其中一些人來說，那是他們第一次真正和小孩互動。

lines.en: And seeing the sheer joy and magic in their face when they are seeing and connecting with this external part of you, it's just so surreal.
lines.zh: 看到他們在和這個「你身體以外的一部分」相見、相處時臉上那純粹的喜悅和驚奇，真的很不真實。

lines.en: I want to do a huge shout-out to all the nannies and caretakers out there.
lines.zh: 我要大大感謝所有的保母和照顧者。

lines.en: A lot of y'all are hidden in the background.
lines.zh: 你們很多人都是默默在幕後付出。

lines.en: I recognize that this is a sensitive topic because of the great privilege it is to have paid help.
lines.zh: 我明白這是個敏感的話題，因為能請人幫忙是一種很大的特權。

lines.en: But I need to spotlight them, because Lennon's nanny is our third parent.
lines.zh: 但我一定要特別提到他們，因為 Lennon 的保母就是我們的第三位家長。

lines.en: Like, we consider her part of the family.
lines.zh: 我們把她當成家人。

lines.en: When we were deciding on who would be Lennon's nanny, the question that we asked was: would I want this person to be my parent?
lines.zh: 我們在決定誰當 Lennon 的保母時，問自己的問題是：我會希望這個人當我的家長嗎？

lines.en: If the answer is yes, then it's a match.
lines.zh: 如果答案是會，那就是她了。

lines.en: Don't be surprised if your professional life takes a backseat.
lines.zh: 如果你的職涯退居次要，不要太驚訝。

lines.en: And before you freak out, it's all temporary.
lines.zh: 在你嚇壞之前，要知道這一切都是暫時的。

lines.en: If I could go back in time, I wish I could tell myself that I don't need to expect the same level of discipline or razor-sharp focus I once had with work.
lines.zh: 如果能回到過去，我希望能告訴自己：不需要期待在工作上維持以前那種程度的紀律和極度專注。

lines.en: Especially the first two years of my son's life.
lines.zh: 尤其是兒子出生後的頭兩年。

lines.en: Even now, I have to remind myself that it's okay if I'm not as productive as I once was.
lines.zh: 就算是現在，我也得提醒自己，沒有以前那麼有生產力也沒關係。

lines.en: I think the first year of postpartum, that's when I found myself growing increasingly frustrated that my work output wasn't the same as before.
lines.zh: 產後第一年，我發現自己越來越沮喪，因為工作產出比不上以前。

lines.en: Pre-kids, I'd be pulling all-nighters all the time, working through the weekend.
lines.zh: 還沒有孩子時，我常常熬夜通宵、週末也照樣工作。

lines.en: But now I have a fixed schedule; it can't really be altered.
lines.zh: 但現在我有固定的作息，幾乎沒辦法更動。

lines.en: And it took me a minute to adjust to this new schedule, because I was just exhausted all the time.
lines.zh: 我花了一段時間才適應這個新作息，因為我總是累壞了。

lines.en: But trust me, it got a lot easier once I accepted this as my new reality.
lines.zh: 但相信我，當我接受這就是我的新日常之後，就輕鬆多了。

lines.en: Yes, I am still learning how to balance it all now.
lines.zh: 是的，我現在還在學習怎麼兼顧一切。

lines.en: But I have hope that things will get even easier as Lennon grows up and becomes more autonomous and independent.
lines.zh: 但我相信，隨著 Lennon 長大、變得更自主獨立，事情會越來越容易。

lines.en: I've read somewhere that the first 5 years of your child's life is the most important.
lines.zh: 我在某處讀到，孩子人生的頭五年最重要。

lines.en: So choosing motherhood is probably going to result in a shifting of priorities or delaying certain career goals.
lines.zh: 所以選擇當媽媽，很可能會讓優先順序改變，或是延後某些職涯目標。

lines.en: But a part of me knows that those career goals and projects will always be there, or maybe they won't.
lines.zh: 但我心裡有一部分知道，那些職涯目標和計畫會一直在那裡，也可能不會。

lines.en: But my child is only a child once, and the time that I'm spending with Lennon right now is truly priceless.
lines.zh: 但我的孩子只會當一次孩子，我現在和 Lennon 相處的時光真的是無價的。

lines.en: He's only a child once, and I know that there is a last time for everything.
lines.zh: 他只會當一次孩子，而我知道每件事都有最後一次。

lines.en: The last time I'll be reading him Llama Llama, the last time I'll be helping him brush his teeth, the last time that he calls out for me at night.
lines.zh: 最後一次為他讀《Llama Llama》、最後一次幫他刷牙、最後一次他半夜喊我。

lines.en: In my 20s, I had put a lot of meaning in my professional world.
lines.zh: 二十幾歲時，我把很多意義放在工作上。

lines.en: I wanted to keep my views up, I wanted to earn respect from my peers, get a specific brand deal.
lines.zh: 我想維持觀看數、想贏得同行的尊敬、想拿到某個品牌合作。

lines.en: And most folks find a lot of meaning in their career achievements.
lines.zh: 大多數人都在職涯成就中找到很多意義。

lines.en: It is like the most obvious path to meaning once you graduate school.
lines.zh: 畢業之後，那幾乎是找到意義最明顯的一條路。

lines.en: Before I had Lennon, it's not like I lacked any sense of purpose in my life.
lines.zh: 在有 Lennon 之前，我並不是人生缺乏目標。

lines.en: But finding all my meaning and self-worth through my career just was not hitting.
lines.zh: 但把所有的意義和自我價值都寄託在事業上，就是不太對勁。

lines.en: The feeling I get from being Lennon's mom transcends any feeling I get from releasing a video or anything that's work-oriented.
lines.zh: 當 Lennon 的媽媽給我的感受，超越了發布一支影片或任何工作帶來的感受。

lines.en: I also want to do a huge disclaimer that you don't need to have kids to feel like you're making an impact in the world or have purpose.
lines.zh: 我也要特別聲明：你不需要有孩子，才能覺得自己對世界有影響、才能有人生目標。

lines.en: A lot of people find great pleasure from community work, activism, working on their own magnum opus, going to church, you fill in the blank.
lines.zh: 很多人從社區服務、社會運動、打造自己的代表作、上教會中得到很大的滿足，其他的你可以自己填空。

lines.en: Having children isn't the one road to find meaning, but it kind of was for me.
lines.zh: 生孩子不是找到意義的唯一道路，但對我來說差不多就是了。

lines.en: I have always had a tendency to overthink the future.
lines.zh: 我一直有想太多未來的傾向。

lines.en: I think it goes hand in hand with my anxiety.
lines.zh: 我想這和我的焦慮是相伴而來的。

lines.en: But after having my son, the passive doomscrolling came to a halt, and there was just this burning desire to take action.
lines.zh: 但有了兒子之後，被動地一直滑負面新聞的習慣停了下來，取而代之的是一股想採取行動的強烈渴望。

lines.en: Because when I look at my son, he represents the future.
lines.zh: 因為當我看著兒子，他代表的就是未來。

lines.en: Because now there is someone so vulnerable walking around that I care about more than myself.
lines.zh: 因為現在有一個如此脆弱、我在乎他勝過自己的人在這世上走來走去。

lines.en: I started to look at all the systems currently in place with such circumspection, especially in media.
lines.zh: 我開始非常審慎地檢視目前所有的體制，尤其是媒體。

lines.en: Like, screen time is something that all parents grapple with.
lines.zh: 像是螢幕時間，是所有父母都在苦惱的問題。

lines.en: The question of how much screen time always pops up, and honestly, there's no universal answer of what the appropriate amount of time is.
lines.zh: 「要給多少螢幕時間」這個問題總會冒出來，老實說，適當的時間是多少，沒有一個放諸四海皆準的答案。

lines.en: But I kind of want to talk about YouTube Kids right now.
lines.zh: 但我現在想談一下 YouTube Kids。

lines.en: It's a platform used for the total and complete maximum attention extraction for the most vulnerable group: our children.
lines.zh: 它是一個用來把最脆弱的族群──我們的孩子──的注意力榨取到極致的平台。

lines.en: It's filled with AI-generated YouTube videos for toddlers, just something so completely alien.
lines.zh: 裡面充滿給幼兒看的 AI 生成影片，完全就是外星產物。

lines.en: No complete storyline, colors maxed out in saturation, repetition that feels rotten.
lines.zh: 沒有完整的故事、顏色飽和度開到最高、重複到讓人覺得腐爛。

lines.en: It was no wonder that when my son was watching it, he was just in a complete trance.
lines.zh: 難怪我兒子看的時候，完全陷入恍神狀態。

lines.en: YouTube Kids is a free platform, but right now it's just pumped with endless ads and content created by people who just see our children's attention as a fast cash grab.
lines.zh: YouTube Kids 是免費平台，但現在充斥著無止盡的廣告，以及把孩子的注意力當成快速撈錢工具的人所做的內容。

lines.en: It was an easy choice for us to switch to slower, less stimulating cartoons, but all of these are behind a paywall.
lines.zh: 我們很容易就決定改看節奏比較慢、刺激比較少的卡通，但這些全都要付費才能看。

lines.en: And so that just made me think: even though we may be protecting our son's mind, what about his peers? What about his generation?
lines.zh: 這讓我開始想：就算我們保護了兒子的心智，那他的同儕呢？他這整個世代呢？

lines.en: I guess what I'm trying to say is, now I'm a lot more aware of the existential threats that can affect Lennon and his generation.
lines.zh: 我想我要說的是，現在我更加意識到那些可能影響 Lennon 和他這一代的根本威脅。

lines.en: I'm also spending a lot more time with kids who were once invisible to me.
lines.zh: 我也花更多時間和以前在我眼裡像是隱形的孩子們相處。

lines.en: Pre-kids, it's like I didn't see any children in the world.
lines.zh: 還沒有孩子時，我好像完全看不見世界上的孩子。

lines.en: Like, if I was on a plane and I saw a baby, I'd be like, "Oh my God, I hope they're not sitting next to me."
lines.zh: 如果我在飛機上看到一個寶寶，我會想：「天啊，希望他不要坐我旁邊。」

lines.en: But now that's not the case.
lines.zh: 但現在不是這樣了。

lines.en: Now whenever I see a baby and a parent on the plane, I not only feel for the parents but also for the baby too.
lines.zh: 現在每當我在飛機上看到寶寶和家長，我不只同情家長，也心疼寶寶。

lines.en: Like, it is very disorienting to be in a pressurized metal tube in the air.
lines.zh: 畢竟待在空中一個加壓的金屬管子裡，是很讓人暈頭轉向的。

lines.en: When I became a mother, I just felt a lot more tethered to the children and grown-ups all around me.
lines.zh: 當了媽媽之後，我覺得自己和身邊的孩子、大人更緊密相連了。

lines.en: It's just like a new sense of compassion, and it's really neat to see humanity come in all different types of age ranges.
lines.zh: 就像一種新的同理心，看到人類以各種不同的年紀存在，真的很棒。

lines.en: It's the end of the day, and I am absolutely shattered.
lines.zh: 一天結束了，我完全累垮了。

lines.en: And if I'm honest, I feel like I've always enjoyed this feeling of complete depletion after a hard day's work.
lines.zh: 老實說，我一直都很享受辛苦工作一整天後徹底耗盡的感覺。

lines.en: But now it feels even more justified to actually rest my head on the pillow and get a deep sleep.
lines.zh: 但現在，把頭靠上枕頭、好好睡一覺，感覺更加理所當然。

lines.en: Because I'm working on probably my biggest gift to humanity: a level-headed, determined, loving, capable human being.
lines.zh: 因為我正在打造的，大概是我給人類最大的禮物：一個冷靜、堅定、有愛又能幹的人。

lines.en: I hope you guys enjoyed this video.
lines.zh: 希望你們喜歡這支影片。

lines.en: Feel free to share any thoughts about your experience on parenthood and what that's been like for you.
lines.zh: 歡迎分享你們當父母的經驗和感受。

lines.en: Anyway, I'm going to call it a night so I can do this all over again tomorrow.
lines.zh: 總之，我要去睡了，明天才能再來一次。

lines.en: Good night.
lines.zh: 晚安。
